name: Whiteboard
summary: Review agent-written code on a visual canvas that links diagrams and decision traces to source files. The free, MIT-licensed desktop app connects to Codex or Claude Code and shows focused diffs of what changed.

name: Antigravity Agent API
summary: Spin up a hosted coding agent with its own Linux sandbox in one API call. It runs code, browses, and edits files on Gemini 3.8 Flash, with preview access for individual free-tier projects.

name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
summary: Design a voice by describing it, pick from 2,000-plus stock voices, or clone one from 30 seconds of audio across 100-plus languages. A cheaper Flash-Lite TTS ships alongside, both live now in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

name: CLM-8B
summary: Make agents choose tools and next actions without paying a language model to write prose. The Apache-2.0 weights, code, fine-tuning guide, TypeSafe-compatible API, and local playground are available now, with reusable action caching for faster decisions.

name: Claude Opus 5.5
summary: Get near-Fable coding and agent quality for about 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads. API pricing is $4 in and $20 out per million tokens, with cheaper cache reads and a faster 2x-priced mode.

name: GPT-6 Sol + Luna
summary: Build coding agents with Sol at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, or high-volume features with Luna at $0.10 and $0.50. Both are available in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

name: MiMo-V2.6 Distill 9B
summary: Run a 9B coding and tool-use model locally, or fine-tune it for an agent. MIT-licensed weights and quantizations are on Hugging Face, making it the practical local option in Xiaomi's V2.6 release.

name: Bonsai 2 27B
summary: Run a 27B reasoning, coding, and vision model on a laptop: ternary weights squeeze it to 5.9GB while keeping 98% of full-precision scores. It has 262K context, Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face, and MLX builds for Mac and iPhone plus CUDA.
